title: Zero-Free Criteria from Signed Liouville Energies
description: The complete manuscript retains the earlier arguments and adds an exact coprime decomposition, a one-sided primitive-correlation criterion, the sharp signed dilation norm and its low-frequency behavior, and the conductor-one lifting calculation. It includes the quantitative Abel-jet obstruction and all earlier appendices. The critical upper estimate and the Riemann and generalized Riemann hypotheses remain unproved.
